title: Pyeongwi-San, a Traditional Digestant, Mitigates Proton Pump Inhibitor-Induced Dyspepsia Through Gut Microbial and Cholinergic Mechanisms in Mice.
snippet: Long-term use of proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) is frequently associated with gastrointestinal (GI) side effects, including dyspepsia, mediated through alterations in gastric pH, impaired GI motility, and gut microbiota dysbiosis.
